results.name: Address validation rejects incomplete, oversized and control-character input without requesting a provider
Census parsing accepts only finite points in the four covered counties and matching states
Ambiguous matches remain selectable, duplicates collapse and out-of-coverage matches cannot become origins
JSONP uses only the fixed HTTPS Census endpoint, explicit address and generated callback; success cleans up
Invalid input and a pre-aborted request create no outgoing lookup
Canceling a pending lookup removes script/callback and ignores a late captured callback
Timeout, load error, malformed response and missing callback reject cleanly without raw-address error text
Replacement lookups have isolated callbacks; canceling the first cannot settle the next request
Address origin controls exact point distances across ZIPs, radius, AND filters and nearest sorting
Any-distance retains list-only records without inventing their distance; nearest sorts them last
Clearing the origin restores ZIP behavior and removes home distances without mutating data
Automatic map initialization and Show on map share one pending load and retry after failure
A later school selection or changed filters suppress a delayed map/cluster popup
UI privacy contracts mask address displays and keep home lookup out of URL/history/storage/inquiry payloads
